description: Background prefetch of the first command's files after the 9p mount (nix/guest/init, elfdeps). September 13, 2026, leviathan, Chromium 151. agent_batch2: think-time runs by variant (control, elf, binlib, blind) at T = 0, 3, 8 s after the welcome line, cores 80-83, three alternating rounds; per-run JSON as the agent's think.py wrote them. exec_bench: tools/exec-bench.py through ab-guest.py with the release engine files and fresh snapshots from the rebuilt native qemu, control against the elf variant (the one shipped), jujutsu and python three rounds, opencode one; the benchmark types the command about a second after the prompt. throttle: the same two sites with Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 12 at 0 and 5 s of think time (the throttle slowed the guest about 1.5x here, not 12x). binonly: the shipped one-line read (cat /share/bin/*) against the elfdeps guest (control2), exec-bench three rounds; think3_binonly: the same two at three seconds of think time, two rounds.
